result_text:
All three default-convention bugs are fixed, and the new test plus the existing `SourceFileFilterTest` pass (9 tests, offline).

Changes, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/`:

- **`GeneratedConventions.java`, pkgdown/Doxygen/meta-generator rules:** the path pattern `.*[.](html|html|xhtml)` is now `.*[.](html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are covered. `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **`GeneratedConventions.java`, .NET doc XML rule:** the path pattern `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. Doing the same for the JavaScript rule (`.*/[.]js` → `.*[.]js`), so `app.js` matches its `// Generated by …` rule.
- **`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`, Gradle JS rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` is still matched by its own rule.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/DefaultConventionsMatchTest.java`. It runs the real default lists against sample paths and content. It covers the `.htm`, `.xml`, `.js` and `build-gradle.js` cases, the still-matching `.html`, `.xhtml` and `build.gradle` cases, and negative cases for hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files.

Nothing is committed.
